The '''Gertafuu system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position within the system was occupied by the [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] astronomical object [[Gertafuu VI]]. The latter was inhabited by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Bartyn's Landing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gertafuu system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square S-18.<ref name="TEA" />
